facts.fact: The article was published on December 19, 2025.
The guide advises changing storefront window displays weekly or bi-weekly to give people a reason to look again.
facts.quote: Change displays regularly (weekly or bi-weekly) to give people a reason to look again.

facts.fact: The guide gives an illustrative in-store-only promotion of 20% off when customers shop in-store (an example, not a sourced statistic).
The guide gives an illustrative loyalty reward of a free item on every 10th visit (an example, not a sourced statistic).
The guide gives an illustrative limited-time offer of the first 50 customers (an example, not a sourced statistic).
Adwave says its streaming TV advertising is accessible starting at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Platforms like [Adwave](https://adwave.com/how-it-works) make streaming TV accessible starting at $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave's streaming TV campaigns can reach every household less than 10 miles from the store, according to the page.
facts.quote: A streaming TV campaign can reach every household less than 10 miles from your store.

facts.fact: The page advises a geotargeting radius of 3-5 miles for most retail stores.
facts.quote: For most retail stores, 3-5 miles works well.

facts.fact: The page advises a geotargeting radius of 1-3 miles for restaurants.
facts.quote: For restaurants, 1-3 miles might be more appropriate.

facts.fact: The page gives an illustrative example that a new window display might increase foot traffic by 10%; this is a hypothetical, not measured data.
facts.quote: A new window display might increase foot traffic 10%.

facts.fact: The page gives an illustrative example that extended weekend hours might drive 20% more weekend visits; this is a hypothetical, not measured data.
facts.quote: Extended hours on weekends might drive 20% more weekend visits.

facts.fact: Adwave's streaming TV commercials run on premium channels named as NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: Your commercial runs on premium channels like NBC, Hulu, and ESPN, building credibility that drives foot traffic over time.
